subject: Money
title: Inflation-Proof Investing
description: A quick win: understand Inflation-Proof Investing.

hook.text: Gold rose 500% from 2001 to 2023. Stocks rose 400%. Savings accounts returned 2% per year. Cash lost.

buildup.text: Assets that rise with inflation—stocks, real estate, commodities—protect purchasing power over time.

discovery.text: TIPS—Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities—adjust value with CPI. The government guarantees your inflation hedge.

twist.text: No asset is perfectly inflation-proof. Stocks crashed 50% in 2008 and 2020. Real estate fell 30% in 2008.

climax.text: Diversification is the only real hedge. Spread risk across asset classes and hope some outrun inflation.

punchline.text: Beat inflation or it beats you.

quiz.question: What are TIPS?
options: Treasury bonds that adjust for inflation
